review_questions.question: Does the overlay keep the pending review gate distinct from an active policy?
Is Normative use prohibited before Human adoption?
Are all original Source Scope Lock target bytes unchanged?
Is the corrective overlay limited to status interpretation and downstream authorization order?
Are classifications, Authority content, claim eligibility, and contamination policies unchanged?
Can the three formally accepted R1 PASS payloads be legally reused?

pass_contract: PASS requires both COMPAT-R1 findings returned as CLOSED with exact IDs and no new OPEN CRITICAL or HIGH finding.
